description: This file defines the WatchConnectivityReceiver class responsible for handling communication between an iOS app and its watch extension using WatchConnectivity. It also includes related data structures and methods for sending messages, activating sessions, and parsing incoming messages.

classes.name: WatchConnectivityReceiver
classes.description: A class managing the WatchConnectivity session, sending messages, and handling received notifications.

methods.name: ensureActivated
methods.description: Ensures the session is activated, waiting asynchronously if necessary.

methods.name: sendReply
methods.description: Sends a reply message to the watch with queued fallback if the watch is unreachable.

methods.name: normalizeObject
methods.description: Normalizes a value into a dictionary with string keys.

methods.name: parseActions
methods.description: Parses actions from a given payload into WatchPromptAction objects.

methods.name: parseNotificationPayload
methods.description: Parses incoming payloads into WatchNotifyMessage objects.
